Definition: neuter of G1727; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:--before, in the presence of.
BiblicalUsage: Enantion is 'before' — in the presence or view of someone. Joseph found favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh in Acts 7:10, Zacharias and Elisabeth were righteous before God in Luke 1:6, and the rulers could not take hold of Jesus' words before the people in Luke 20:26. Isaiah's sheep was dumb before his shearer in Acts 8:32.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'before God' is the only audience that finally matters — Joseph's favour came from standing well in Pharaoh's sight, but Zacharias and Elisabeth were righteous in God's sight, and that is the sight I want my life to pass. I hold that a life lived before God needs no other stage.
